I sent 3 tickets with photos of payment and showing no access. Nothing was solved and they erased my account. I contacted the instructor on Facebook. She send me messages through Pateron but the message button does not work and therefore I can't reply back. Basically, left out in the cold. I asked for a refund on my last ticket and no reply back. I believe they scam people out of money and impossible to contact."
